## Course description

The process of spiritual formation is intentionally engaged so that habits developed through theological education form students holistically for ministry.

## Program goals

Calvin Seminary forms graduates who discern, with those they serve, answers to four connected questions — **Context**, **Gospel**, **Calling**, **Person**. Every ministry situation occurs in a *context* where the *gospel* is communicated, where God is *calling* people to his mission, and where God forms the *person* and role of a servant leader.

## Learning outcomes

- **Context:** Discern how your history, beliefs, and behaviors shape your ability to love God and others.
- **Gospel:** Describe the basic disciplines of the Christian life and their fruit; describe how identity and character are shaped by coursework and ministry practice.
- **Calling:** Discern ways to encourage individual and communal formation through the classic disciplines.
- **Person:** Practice disciplines that sustain a soft heart and thick skin; develop and sustain a Rhythm of Life with a Formation Group / accountability partner / mentor; articulate how formation habits support servant leadership.

## Grading

| Component | Weight |
|-----------|-------:|
| Class participation (incl. quizzes) | 20% |
| 8 Reading Responses | 40% |
| Rhythm of Life | 20% |
| Final Exam | 20% |

Reading Responses: **2** Pass · **1** Poor pass · **0** Fail; term average must be 2 or the grade is pulled down. **Late Reading Responses are not accepted.** Late Rhythm of Life loses one full grade per day.

## Written-work standards

Double-spaced, page numbers, 1" margins, name + due date + title on page 1. In-text citation for required readings (author, page); footnotes for other sources. Depth of engagement, correct understanding, clear organization, and quality of writing all count. Use inclusive language.
